composition.serve_who: Sheet 12 of dwg 196D5023 (BAE Systems Controls harness/pinout series) shows two nearly identical wiring/pinout blocks, BEL1-S and BEL2-S, each terminating a chain-segment cable (S3 and S4 respectively) that feeds three connector groups: a BEL connector (RTN1 battery-return pin), a SYNC twisted-pair connector, and a CAN-A connector (Shield/HI/LO). The naming convention "G3-S3xxx" / "G3-S4xxx" and terminal-strip labels BEL1-S / BEL2-S match the established BAE BEL identity already on the vessel's electrical nodes (629-bel1-s, 629-bel2-s — "BEL-1/BEL-2 converter, STBD"), so this sheet's two chain segments are read as the internal signal/CAN/sync wiring for BEL1-S (chain S3) and BEL2-S (chain S4). No breakers, fuses, or control logic are drawn; this is purely point-to-point interconnect data (loop membership) for those two BEL units' sync/CAN daisy chain, consistent with rule set 629-bel's existing CAN-bus / SYNC protective-device facts (CBx4 CAN BUS ISOLATORS, CBx11 BEL-SYNC) already recorded upstream.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Terminal strip explicitly labeled BEL1-S with net names prefixed G3-S3... matches the established BAE BEL1-S (STBD) converter node; this sheet supplies its internal SYNC/CAN/battery-return wiring, not a new device.

functions.label: BEL1-S chain wiring (S3 segment): battery return, sync, CAN-A bus, chain supply/output
functions.what_it_does: Carries the BEL1-S unit's chain-segment (S3) I/O between its terminal strip and its BEL/SYNC/CAN-A connector group: battery return to the BEL connector RTN1 pin, a sync twisted pair to the SYNC connector, and a CAN-A daisy-chain (Shield/HI/LO) to the CAN-A connector, plus chain-supply/chain-output and freq-select signals on the terminal strip.

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S3R1 VBATTERY RTN from BEL1-S terminal pin 7 via twisted/crossed wire pair to BEL connector pin RTN1; net also carries as G3-S3R1 SYNC_RTN to SYNC connector; SYNC connector pins 10 and 3 carry G3-S3S2 SYNC signal (terminal pin 3) — sync return path closes at BEL1-S terminal pin 7/3.

G3-S3AH CANA_HI (terminal pin 5) and G3-S3AL CANA_LO (terminal pin 6) route via crossed twisted-pair wiring to CAN-A connector HI/LO pins; G3-S3AS CANA_Shield (N/C terminal pin) routes to CAN-A Shield pin with a dashed-oval shield-drain/splice termination shown on the shield and LO lines.

flow_scenarios.state: chain supply/output and freq-select (unused address/enable lines)
flow_scenarios.path: G3-S3S1 FREQ_SELECT (pin 2), G3-S321 CHAIN_OUTPUT (pin 11), G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY (pin 10) terminate at the BEL1-S terminal strip; G3-S329 ENABLE (pin 1), G3-S300a ADR_0 (pin 8), G3-S300b ADR_1 (pin 9) are marked N/C (not connected/populated on this chain segment).

key_components: dashed-oval shield-drain/splice termination on CANA_Shield and CANA_LO run
functions.dry_data: Terminal strip BEL1-S, I/O pins 2/7/11/3/1/8/9/5/6/N-C/10/4; no protective devices shown on this sheet (fuses/breakers reside upstream per established 629-bel facts: CBx4 CAN bus isolators, CBx11 BEL-SYNC, CBx.4 retractable CAN-bus fuse).
functions.sheet_region: Upper block, columns G-F rows 3-7 (BEL1-S terminal strip lower-left ~row7; BEL/SYNC/CAN-A connectors upper area ~row3)

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Terminal strip explicitly labeled BEL2-S with net names prefixed G3-S4... mirrors the BEL1-S block and matches the established BAE BEL2-S (STBD) converter node.

functions.label: BEL2-S chain wiring (S4 segment): battery return, sync, CAN-A bus, chain supply/output
functions.what_it_does: Carries the BEL2-S unit's chain-segment (S4) I/O between its terminal strip and its BEL/SYNC/CAN-A connector group, mirroring BEL1-S's wiring pattern: battery return to BEL connector RTN1, sync twisted pair to SYNC connector, CAN-A daisy chain to CAN-A connector, plus chain-supply/chain-output/freq-select terminal signals.
